description: Declarative classification rules for Coventry City Council monthly spend-over-500 CSVs. Coventry is a metropolitan-borough unitary covering all functions (Education, Adult Social Care, Children's, Highways, Housing). Default is procurement_paid. REDACTED variants bucket to direct_payment_individual. Pension Fund transfers bucket to internal_transfer. NHS pass-throughs (Coventry & Warwickshire ICB / UH Coventry & Warwickshire) bucket to statutory_pass_through.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL|PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL|INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions covering ASC direct payments, foster carer / SGO allowances, CYP direct payments. Lawfully unnamed — not third-party procurement.
West Midlands Pension Fund — LGPS scheme. Money moving inside the council group, not external procurement.

match.supplier_regex: ^(NHS COVENTRY (AND|&) WARWICKSHIRE ICB( \(QWU\))?|COVENTRY (AND|&) RUGBY (CLINICAL COMMISSIONING GROUP|CCG)|UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS COVENTRY (AND|&) WARWICKSHIRE NHS TRUST|COVENTRY (AND|&) WARWICKSHIRE PARTNERSHIP NHS TRUST|GEORGE ELIOT HOSPITAL NHS TRUST|WARWICKSHIRE COUNTY COUNCIL)$

rules.reason: BCF s.75 pooled budget transfers to NHS commissioning bodies + county-pass-through for shared service-area contributions (Section 75 NHS Act 2006). Legally ring-fenced. ICB names include (QWU) parenthetical suffix and use '&' rather than 'AND'.
